correctness.rationale: For all complex 2x2 matrices use Tr((X*X)^2)=F^2-2|det X|^2. Under unimodular entrywise multiplication F is fixed. For ratio greater than one, optimizing decreasing ratio in F^2 gives pairwise equal magnitudes; optimizing increasing ratio in normalized product p then forces all four moduli equal. The remaining sharp one-phase inequality is equivalent to 8k^2-2(9-c)k+8≥0, whose larger root is K(c). Its equality trig vector has exact unit length and yields all extremizers. Endpoints eta=1 and eta=-1 separately checked. The cb claim invokes the inspected external Theorem 3.2 of Arhancet and is not inferred from finite tests. The NumPy checker executes 8418 corroborative deterministic checks.
